functions.name: core_scope_init
functions.brief: Start the module on the Core's default link.

functions.name: core_scope_set_link
functions.brief: Stream over a different link than the default.

params.name: link
params.description: Link to use; must outlive the program. NULL = no link.

functions.name: core_scope_add
functions.signature: core_scope_add(const char * name, const volatile void * ptr, core_scope_type_t type)
functions.brief: Register one variable as a channel.

params.name: name
params.description: Channel name shown on the plot. Not copied — must outlive the program (a string literal).

params.name: ptr
params.description: The variable. Read on every sample, so it must stay valid (static or global, not a local).

functions.return_desc: 0 on success, -1 if the table or the schema frame is full.

functions.name: core_scope_add_array
functions.signature: core_scope_add_array(const char * name, const volatile void * ptr, core_scope_type_t type, uint8_t count)
functions.brief: Register a fixed array as channels `name[0]` .. `name[count-1]`.
functions.return_desc: 0 on success, -1 if they do not all fit (none are added).

functions.name: core_scope_set_interval_ms
functions.brief: Limit core_scope_update() to one sample per `ms` milliseconds.

functions.name: core_scope_declare_rate_hz
functions.brief: Promise that samples are taken at exactly this rate.

functions.name: core_scope_declare_rate_millihertz
functions.brief: As core_scope_declare_rate_hz(), in millihertz — for rates that are not a whole number of hertz (an IMU at 416.667 Hz = 416667).

functions.name: core_scope_pump
functions.brief: Frame the pending samples and hand them to the link. Main loop.

functions.name: core_scope_update
functions.brief: core_scope_sample() + core_scope_pump(), honoring the interval gate. The one call a simple main loop needs.

functions.name: core_scope_enable
functions.brief: Pause or resume at run time (a debug button, a BLE command).

params.name: on
params.description: 0 = paused: calls cost one branch. Non-zero = running.

functions.name: core_scope_active
functions.brief: Is a host listening right now?
functions.return_desc: Non-zero while samples are being streamed.

functions.name: core_scope_dropped
functions.brief: Samples dropped since boot because the ring was full.

types.name: core_scope_type_t
types.brief: Channel value types — the wire type codes of docs/scope-protocol.md.

members.name: CORE_SCOPE_BOOL
members.description: bool in memory, travels as int32 0/1

types.name: core_scope_link_t
types.brief: A link carries the framed byte stream to the host. USB and BLE ship with the SDK; anything with a write function (a UART, a radio module) can be a link too — see core_scope_set_link().

macros.name: core_scope_watch
macros.brief: Register `var` as a channel named after itself.

macros.name: core_scope_watch_as
macros.brief: Register `var` under a display name of your choosing.

macros.name: core_scope_watch_array
macros.brief: Register the first `count` elements of array `arr` as `arr[0]`, `arr[1]`, …
